name: toolchest
description: Claude Code skills, hooks and output styles

plugins.name: awl
plugins.description: Roslyn semantic analysis on every C# edit (alpha). Carries awl.dll and runs it with dotnet; needs the .NET 10 runtime

plugins.name: gimlet
plugins.description: C#/.NET security scan runner (opengrep rules, SDK Security analyzers, Dotnetarium, NuGet and OSV package checks, Betterleaks) and running-API probe (Spectral, Schemathesis, ZAP), with a skill for triaging and fixing findings. Downloads pinned tools on first use; needs curl and jq

plugins.name: lam
plugins.description: Local Agent Monitor: advisory checks on edits and deletions with per-check correction counts, a status line, a /guard-stats pane, and a git fetch at session start

plugins.name: loom
plugins.description: TypeScript, JavaScript and Vue analysis on every edit (alpha, linux-x64 and windows-x64). Runs on the machine's Bun and carries its engine; needs Bun on PATH

plugins.name: refactoring
plugins.description: Code health, architecture, dead code, pattern and defect scans, plus the feature-architect, task-implementer and implementation-reviewer agents, with the git gate on task-implementer

plugins.name: session
plugins.description: Hand over and resume work across sessions

plugins.name: testing
plugins.description: Mutation testing and test noise audits

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: House writing style and response output styles
